purpose: Explicit inventory of known backend database integrity gaps. This file is a contract target for tests; remove entries only when a migration and model-level FK or constraint closes the gap.

canonical_identifier_policy.teachers.id: Teacher profile identifier. Teacher-owned domain rows must reference teachers.id, not users.id, unless the row is explicitly account-scoped.
canonical_identifier_policy.students.id: Student profile identifier. Student-owned domain rows must reference students.id, not users.id, unless the row is explicitly account-scoped.
canonical_identifier_policy.parents.id: Parent profile identifier. Parent-child and parent-teacher domain rows must reference parents.id.
canonical_identifier_policy.subscriptions.id: Tuition subscription/pass identifier. Schedule-change session events reference this id plus session_number.

unresolved_foreign_key_gaps.reason: Student profiles can be linked to app accounts; nullable legacy rows need cleanup before FK enforcement.
Student rows are teacher-owned, but ownership is currently protected only by service checks.
Parent profile uniqueness exists, but account linkage is not FK-protected.
Relation rows drive access decisions and must not outlive the teacher profile.
Relation rows drive access decisions and must not outlive the student profile.
Class ownership is teacher-scoped and used by membership/subscription authorization.
Subscriptions already reference memberships, so membership parent class integrity is foundational.
Memberships bind students to class/subscription access.
Membership location references can currently point at deleted or unrelated locations.
Lesson history, practice items, recordings, and subscription usage depend on valid student ownership.
Teacher-visible lesson history should not be orphaned from teacher profiles.
Some historical lessons are standalone; active subscription-linked lessons need cleanup before FK enforcement.
Practice library data is student-owned and should be removed or reassigned with the student.
Sections cannot be meaningful without a repertoire parent.
Practice recordings are section-scoped and currently can become orphaned.
Practice notes are section-scoped and currently can become orphaned.
Parent visibility and child profile APIs rely on valid parent-child relations.
Parent visibility and child profile APIs rely on valid parent-child relations.
Availability is teacher-owned and feeds booking/schedule-change suggestions.
Time slots cannot be interpreted without their availability parent.
Lesson request chat and schedule-change events require a valid teacher endpoint.
Lesson request chat and schedule-change events require a valid student endpoint.

business_constraint_gaps.rule: status, deposit_status, payment_confirmed, paid_at, and payment_confirmed_at must transition consistently for manual deposits
day_of_week in 0..6 (DB check constraint added: ck_teacher_availabilities_day_of_week)
end_time must be after start_time (DB check) and slot ranges must not overlap within one availability (service-level validation)
duration > 0 and cancellation statuses require the matching cancellation timestamp or policy event
parent-teacher connection uniqueness may need student_id in the key when multiple children share a teacher
read_at is the red-dot source of truth; future unread counters must derive from it or an audited aggregate

backend_notes: RequestEvent.subscription_id has a real FK to subscriptions.id.
The pending endpoint returns latest visible session events that require the current teacher or student to respond.
SubscriptionService validates turn order for terminal schedule-change responses.
Parents can read linked child events but cannot create schedule-change events.
